name: Docking: the sugar mountain's width and height
description: Axtell et al. 1996's mobility experiment (15 traits) across the width σ and height of its "single (Gaussian) sugar mountain" (capacities round(height · e^(−d²/2σ²))); the paper gives neither. They report 1.1 ± 0.3 cultures. Measured (seeds 1–5, mean cultures, recorded 2026-09-30), σ = 8, 12, 16, 20, 25, 50: height 2: 75, 68, 56, 41, 24, 1.4; height 3: 54, 42, 24, 8, 1.6, 1.6; height 4: 42, 30, 11, 2, 1, 1.2; height 6: 31, 17, 2.6, 1, 1.2, 1.2; height 10: 22, 6.4, 1, 1.2, 1.4. Their result reproduces on any mountain broad or tall enough (σ ≥ 20 at height 4, σ ≥ 16 at height 6–10, σ = 50 at any height) and not on narrow, low ones.
